cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL219, from New York to Wuhan. You are maintaining 11000m over OBLIK, squawk number is 3566. Call wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是美联航219，从纽约飞往武汉，你现在保持在11000米，过OBLIK，应答机编码3566，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, UAL219, 11000m over OBLIK, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航219,11000米，过OBLK，应答机3566。

cards.audioText: UAL 219, Wuhan control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 9200m, expedite descend until passing 9800m due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，武汉区调，雷达识别，下降并保持9200米，由于通过航空器，加速下降直到过9800米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 9200m, expedite descend until passing 9800m, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持9200米，加速下降直到过9800米。

cards.audioText: You are now maintaining 9200m and are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence (CAT). Inform ATC of this situation and request further descent to 8400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在保持在9200米，你正在经历中度晴空颠簸，告知管制员此情况，请求进一步下降到8400米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, UAL219, maintaining 9200m. Request further descent to 8400m due moderate clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航219，目前在9200米保持，由于中度晴空颠簸，请求进一步下降到8400米。

cards.audioText: UAL219, continue descent and maintain 8400m, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，继续下降并保持在8400米，到达后报。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 8400m, wilco, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持在8400米，照办，美联航219。

cards.audioText: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock. Check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: TCAS显示，9点钟方向有一架快速移动的航空器，与武汉区调确认，是否为冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, UAL219, TCAS shows a traffic at 9 o'clock. Confirm it is a conflicting aircraft?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航219，TCAS显示9点钟方向有一架航空器，确认是否为冲突航空器？

cards.audioText: UAL219, negative, that aircraft is military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly. Report traffic in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，不是，该飞机为一架军机，与你现在的航迹平行飞行，不久将超过你。看到航空器后报。

cards.audioText: Now that aircraft has passed you. Report to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，航空器冲突已解除，报告给管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, UAL219, clear of traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航219，与航空器解除冲突。

cards.audioText: UAL219, reduce to minimum speed. Track direct to ZF, expect ZF-3 arrival RWY 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，减小到最小速度，直飞ZF，预计ZF-3进场，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Reduce to minimum speed. Track direct to ZF, ZF-3 arrival RWY 36R, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减小到最小速度，直飞ZF，预计ZF-3进场，跑道36右，美联航219。

cards.audioText: UAL219, continue descent to and maintain 4200m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，继续下降并保持在4200米。
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持在4200米，美联航219。

cards.audioText: You are now leveling at 4200m and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航219，保持在4200米，接近ZF，通播A。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan approach, UAL219 maintaining 4200m, approaching ZF, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航219，保持在4200米，接近ZF，通播A。

cards.audioText: Now you have established ILS approach RWY 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你已经建立了ILS进近，跑道36右，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL219, established ILS approach RWY 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航219，建立ILS进近，跑道36右。

cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，继续进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，跑道36右，美联航219。

cards.audioText: All stations! All stations! Be advised RWY 36R is closed due to an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break break, UAL219, fly heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 各台注意，各台注意，通知下，由于一架故障飞机占用跑道，跑道36右关闭，断开，断开，美联航219，航向360，爬升并保持1500米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500m, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，航向360，爬升并保持1500米，美联航219。

cards.audioText: UAL219, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR/DME approach RWY 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，右转航向170，预计雷达引导，VOR/DME进近，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR/DME approach RWY 04, UAL219
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向170，预计雷达引导，VOR/DME进近，跑道04，美联航219。

cards.audioText: UAL219, turn right heading 310, cleared for the VOR/DME approach RWY 04, report inbound.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近，跑道04，向台报，美联航219。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 310, cleared for VOR/DME approach RWY 04, report inbound, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近，跑道04，向台报，美联航219。

cards.audioText: You are now inbound course for RWY 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在进入跑道04向台航迹，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL219, VOR/DME approach RWY 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航219，VOR/DME进近，跑道04。
